about.title: Behind the scene.
about.intro: A brief introduction of who I am, my background and what drives me.
about.p1: My name is Gabriel, but you can call me Hermont. I've been passionate about technology since I was a kid, and I found my path when I had my first contact with programming logic back in school. Since then, I dove headfirst into this world and want to go deeper every day.
about.p2: Today I'm a Software Engineering student at PUC Minas, combining creativity and technical knowledge to solve problems and make a real impact. My goal is to keep evolving — using logical reasoning, critical thinking and the right tools, including AI as an ally — to build better and better solutions.
about.p3: Away from the code, I'm a die-hard Atlético-MG fan, a lover of films, music and video games, and I play sports whenever I can.
